title: True resolution payload
summary: JSON Schema for the true-resolution detector payload - container and effective size, upscale factor per axis, spectral cut-off, verdict and per-tile share.
description: Emitted as the envelope payload by video_re_detect_true_resolution; the envelope itself follows the baltor.video-detection/v1 schema.

review.notes: Valid example validates and invalid example fails (Draft 2020-12); the detector's tests validate every emitted payload against this schema.
